BiblicalUsage: Tarea was a Benjamite, the son of Micah of the family of Saul. The Chronicler names him once, in the genealogy of Saul's house after the kingdom had passed to David. The name means chamber of a neighbour, and the man behind it is otherwise unknown.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogies honour men like Tarea on purpose: a name kept when the kingdom was lost, and a family remembered even after its crown was gone.
